You are right, and the correction is supported. Nabíl's list of the Ṭabarsí martyrs has *"Mullá Báqir, brother of Mullá Mihdí, both of whom were men of considerable learning, to whose great attainments Bahá'u'lláh testifies in the 'Kitáb-i-Íqán.'" ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=153.%20Mull%C3%A1%20B%C3%A1qir%2C%20brother,testifies%20in%20the%20%E2%80%9CKit%C3%A1b%2Di%2D%C3%8Dq%C3%A1n))* ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=153.%20Mull%C3%A1%20B%C3%A1qir%2C%20brother%20of%20Mull%C3%A1%20Mihd%C3%AD%2C%20both,testifies%20in%20the%20Kitab-i-Iqan)) That ties the Íqán's Mullá Báqir to the brother of Mullá Mihdí, whose companion appears in the Íqán list directly after Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585)).

I also withdraw the closing line of my row 11, which said he was not Mullá Báqir-i-Tabrízí, a Letter of the Living. The passage I cited for it was not about him, and the Letter of the Living is a different man, so that line should not have been there.

**Revised row 11**

| # | Name in the Íqán | Who he was | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | Mullá Báqir | The brother of Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí (row 10). Both were men of considerable learning, and Nabíl records that Bahá'u'lláh attests to their attainments in the Íqán. He was martyred at Ṭabarsí. A Letter of the Living of the same name is a different man, and is not this one. | Nabíl, *The Dawn-Breakers*, Ṭabarsí martyr no. 153 ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=153.%20Mull%C3%A1%20B%C3%A1qir%2C%20brother%20of%20Mull%C3%A1%20Mihd%C3%AD%2C%20both,testifies%20in%20the%20Kitab-i-Iqan)); Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
